images.filename: New Refurbished Ivory Tower at Makerere University.jpg
images.caption:
The Makerere University Ivory Tower gutted fire in 2020 which the Criminal Investigation Department at the Ministry of works reported that it was caused by a short circuit rose from a faulty electrical system.
Makerere University launched a fundraiser to help restore the administration building also known as "The Main Building" famously known as "The Ivory Tower."

Several office equipment and other valuable information were damaged during the Sunday 20th September 2020 night fire. The fire broke out at the Main Building alias Ivory Tower at Makerere University at 1:05am, according to police.
